body: [{"streamId":"01a0f96f-ae0b-7363-a06e-9a419c12bed2","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a0f96f-ae0b-7363-a06e-9a419c12bed2\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022A mention follow-up runs only when this install\\u0027s own login is the one the comment tags, and the record says which login was tagged\u0022},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022PullRequestReviewMentionObserved records the mentioned login alongside the comment author\u0022,\u0022The pending mention follow-up path in RunLauncher re-checks before launching that the comment tags this install\\u0027s login and was not written by it, and records a skip without a session when either check fails\u0022,\u0022h9k task show and the mention-followup prompt name the comment author and the tagged login separately, and neither claims the author tagged this install unless it did\u0022,\u0022A unit test, with no database, no branch, and no GitHub, replays #2166 from the task owner\\u0027s side: a mention attached to this owner\\u0027s task that tags another login, or was written by this install\\u0027s own login, is skipped before launch with the skip recorded and no session started (Brian, 2026-10-02)\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022A mention follow-up never checks that this install\\u0027s own login was the one tagged. PullRequestReviewMentionObserved (src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Tasks/Events/PullRequestReviewMentionObserved.cs:39-48) records the comment\\u0027s author, not the mentioned login. RunLauncher\\u0027s pending-follow-up branch (RunLauncher.cs:163-180) rebuilds the comment from the task\\u0027s latest-mention fields without re-applying the self-author filter (GitHubReviewAssignments.cs:482-484) or checking who was tagged. The prompt template (.claude/templates/mention-followup-prompt-builder/build.md:4) then tells the session the author \\u0022tagged this install\\u0027s own login\\u0022. The \\u0022Tagged by\\u0022 row in h9k task show (TaskShowCommand.cs:328) shows the author under a label that reads as the tagged login.\\n\\n## Motivating case: AgelessRx/arx-platform#2166, pr-review task bc7d2572 (2026-10-01 EDT)\\n\\n- bc7d2572 is Brian\\u0027s (Hallmanac) pr-review task for #2166, scope Team, assigned to Brian Hall. It had been parked merge-ready since about noon.\\n- 11:49 Taylor Dennison (taylor-dennison) asked a question on the PR.\\n- 17:21:23 Brian replied as Hallmanac, mentioning @taylor-dennison (issue comment 5940862269). The comment answered Taylor; nothing in it was for Brian.\\n- 17:23 feed: \\u0022bc7d2572 claimed by TaylorDenny as a deliberate kick-off; a run is starting\\u0022. Taylor\\u0027s install had a real mention of its own login, found Brian\\u0027s replicated task by external reference with no owner filter, and claimed it through TaskDecider.ClaimForMentionFollowUp. That claim carries the empty node id, so the feed (OrchestratorFeedDescription.cs:124-125) labelled it a deliberate kick-off. That label is wrong.\\n- 17:26 feed: \\u0022bc7d2572 claimed by node ef6ab27d\\u0022. The order here is inferred from the code: Taylor\\u0027s safe pre-flight requeued the task with PendingMentionFollowUpAfterPreflight (RunSupervisor.cs:352-357), still assigned to Brian. Brian\\u0027s dispatcher claimed it and took the pending-follow-up branch (RunLauncher.cs:163-180).\\n- 17:27 parked with a mention-followup addendum, run 01a0f95c-a4cc-7362-a7c8-bfd6ba613d3a, reading \\u0022Tagged by Hallmanac\\u0022. The session found no question for Brian and drafted nothing.\\n\\nEvidence comes from a code trace at v0.11.3 (e03c7d7e6). Mention match and self-author filter: src/Hall9k.Connectors/WorkItems/GitHubReviewAssignments.cs:439-440, 482-484. Attach: src/Hall9k.Daemon/AutoPrReview/AutoPrReviewEngine.cs:2058-2409, with the covering-task lookup at 2067-2076. Receive gate: src/Hall9k.Connectors/Replication/EventReplicationInbox.cs:2013, Owner-role pass-through around 2045-2048.\\n\\n\\n\\n## Walked 2026-10-02 (Brian)\\n\\nOne task, stacked on nothing, buildable alongside 5f6b4783 (the only overlap is where the mention event is recorded). This card stays needed after 5f6b4783: that fix only protects installs running the new version, and a teammate on an older daemon (Ryan is on 0.10.50) could still attach a stray mention to this owner\\u0027s task, so the pre-launch re-check is this owner\\u0027s own guard regardless of teammates\\u0027 versions.\u0022},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-02T14:20:05.97421\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"cde56c9b-7ab5-4db1-b060-fa7d1e6c78af","originSequence":85233,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-02T14:20:05.987637+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
